QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_7

question.text: Sahyadri Stat-Arb Fund delivered annualised return of 18% over 3 years with Maximum Drawdown of 12%. What is the Calmar Ratio?

explanation.text: The Logic: Calmar = Annualised Return / |MDD| = 18% / 12% = 1.50. Calmar > 1 is attractive; > 3 is elite. It's popular for trend-following / managed-futures funds where drawdown control is the key risk sold to LPs. The Trap: 0.67 inverts ratio. 2.16 uses cumulative not annualised return. 1.06 adds Rf noise. Cross-Exam Context: Cross-test with XIX-D Cat I/II where Calmar rarely appears; XIX-E Cat III funds (especially managed futures / macro) market themselves on Calmar. Manager's Pro-Tip: Use a 36-month rolling Calmar for LP reports — point-in-time Calmar can be flattering after a recovery year that washes out a recent drawdown.
